editorial: Even before the first breath of the courtroom’s fluorescent hum, you sense the pulse of a man on the brink of losing all he owns. What sets this dark legal thriller apart is the way it lets a quiet, coal‐black detective’s inner monologue echo the stubborn, unfinished truth, turning every interrogation into a chess move. A single clip of the protagonist framing evidence beside a shattered trophy on a rain‐soaked podium feels like a visual stanza that could have been written in a different language. If you thrive on the unraveling of corruption under a flickering bad light, you will be pulled into this courtroom drama’s relentless grind. A pacing hiccup mid‐act—when exposition slides into a three‐minute montage—only slightly dents the razor‐sharp chase that follows.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
